registryEvidence.basis: The first-party Kherson regional StateGeoCadastre site publishes a cadastral-map information procedure specifically for Kherson, names the Kherson administrative-service centre, and links the official public cadastral map. This establishes a territorial cadastral custodian/procedure, but not an open parcel feature endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Official State Enterprise Centre of State Land Cadastre landing page links the Public Cadastral Map.
Official Kherson regional procedure for cadastral-map extracts; page names the Kherson regional StateGeoCadastre and Kherson administrative-service centre.
Official National Geoportal documentation describes parcel search and the safe public fields exposed in its information panel.

remainingUncertainty: The official viewer may require additional client-side routes, may be unavailable from this environment, or may expose geometry only through a different public service.
